# RAGbase Shield stopwords (English). Written for RAGbase Shield, Apache-2.0.
# Words that are never part of a person or company name, even when they start with a capital letter
# (sentence start, headings, e-mail headers, chat lines). Matching is case and accent insensitive.
# Sections (read by ragbase_shield.engine.locale, bundle("en")):
#   [stopwords]   function words and sentence-initial words
#   [months_days] month and day names and their abbreviations (dates stay in clear)
#   [greetings]   salutation and sign-off words: the word after one is a first name ("Hi Priya,")
#   [titles]      civility and professional titles before a name ("Dr. Ravikar"); the title stays in clear

# [stopwords]
